description: Check an email for accessibility basics. Pass `html`. Reports: missing lang and title, layout tables without role="presentation", images with no alt or throwaway alt (image, photo, a file name), very long alt text, links with vague wording (click here, read more, here), links with underline removed and no other cue, heading structure (none, or skipped levels), color contrast of text and background set on the same element (WCAG 1.4.3, 4.5:1), small text, all-caps blocks, and text locked inside images. Static checks only; it does not replace a screen reader pass. Email client support notes are from our own testing notes dated 2026-10 and may have drifted. Confirm in real clients (Litmus, Email on Acid, or seed accounts) before sending.
name: check_email_accessibility
title: Email accessibility check
